reliability_selection_contract.candidate_relaxation: include the highest-ranked 256 when the requested top quantile is smaller
reliability_selection_contract.confidence: tie-aware percentile rank within source view

cross_view_support.definition: fraction of available other views confirming projected z-depth
cross_view_support.evidence: nearest projected pixel, object mask, original fusion confidence threshold and z-depth agreement
cross_view_support.single_view: neutral constant; no effect on within-record ordering

reliability_selection_contract.downstream_sampling: identity because selector already emits exactly 256

local_plane_agreement.definition: inverse within-view rank of absolute point-to-neighbor-plane distance divided by local RMS radius

reliability_selection_contract.mask_edge_distance: within-view rank of in-mask Euclidean distance to background or image edge
reliability_selection_contract.spatial_uniformity: seeded FPS over reliability candidate pool

stop_decision.coverage_excluded: 8192-GT-to-256-input coverage is a sampling-density diagnostic, not a cloud-completeness gate
stop_decision.metric_population: all paired records; exact-256 validity is a mandatory gate

target.coverage_reason: 8192-to-256 nearest-neighbor coverage measures sample density, not point-cloud completeness
